changes.esrch: Only zero-byte ESRCH with complete valid live same-owner/group BSD anchors one immediate additional task read; no added sleep or recursion. Recovered full counters require the same birth; a new live generation stays unknown for group inventory. Explicit owned-generation replacement semantics remain distinct.
changes.failureEvidence: Separate bounded before/after cleanup diagnostic-shape records, maximum 128 KiB read and 16 retained records, fixed message classes and Rust diagnostic codes only; no arbitrary text, paths, argv, environment or quoted values.
changes.markerMeaning: Rename the generic compiler-error regex count to error-marker; explicitly label it as post-cleanup text matches, not a compiler verdict.

tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONWARNINGS=error::ResourceWarning python -m unittest test_owned_cleanup test_native_processes test_ps_lifetime test_guards test_failure_recovery -q
tests.skipReason: Existing actual macOS libproc gates; current development host is Linux.

limits.remainingGate: Representative actual Mac recheck/churn validation with fixed negative controls before another full build.

kernelSource.observation: The task-all-info and BSD-info flavors perform distinct lookups; only BSD-info with nonzero arg enables zombie lookup. This permits lookup observations to differ and does not make ESRCH or a live-looking BSD record sufficient to prove disappearance. The exact historical generation at the failed task query was not observed.
